title: ws/mod.rs send_request: String::from on literals — use into() or literal.to_owned()
description: ws/mod.rs lines 104 and 108 (test) call .to_string() and .to_owned() on string literals interchangeably. Lines 104 and 328 in tests also call .to_string() on string literals to produce serde_json map keys. This is a minor inconsistency: .to_owned() is idiomatic for &str-to-String; .to_string() on a literal dispatches through Display. Not a bug, but a Rust practitioner reviewing the code would notice the inconsistency within the same file.
